# Sigmacta

> Sigmacta is a privacy-first social network for personal growth: chat, stories, a feed, free music/podcasts/audiobooks, communities, and yearly goals with a built-in AI coach. Built and maintained solo by Jakhangir Omirbaev.

## What it is

Sigmacta bundles into one app: 1:1 and group chat, a social feed with stories and reels, a free music/podcast/audiobook player called Rhythm, communities, and a personal-growth layer (yearly goals + an AI coach) — instead of needing five separate apps.

## Key facts

- Sign-up requires only a username and password — no email or phone number.
- Core features (chat, feed, stories, Rhythm, communities) are free. An optional "Sigmacta Pro" subscription adds a custom name badge (GIF/emoji), no ads, and extended AI features (including voice mode for the AI coach). Official account verification (the blue checkmark) is separate and not purchasable — it's granted after a manual identity/notability review.
- Available as a native Android app on Google Play, and as a web app for iPhone (installable via Safari's "Add to Home Screen").
- Built entirely by one person, no team, no investors.
